name: Hibiki
source: Spirit of an aspiring pianist who died of exhaustion while preparing for a recital. He's hopelessly tone-deaf. Before his death he used to work in banking. [spoiler]He's close friends with [url=https://vndb.org/c53020]Noboru[/url]. He haunts the music room.[spoiler]
